gaps.sentence: ___ curiosity killed the cat, as they say.
gaps.explanation: 'Curiosity' as an abstract quality takes no article, even in the proverb.

gaps.sentence: He plays ___ violin in the youth orchestra.
___ young woman at reception speaks five languages.
gaps.explanation: 'The young woman at reception' — defined by the location phrase.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).

gaps.sentence: ___ water in this bottle tastes strange.
gaps.explanation: The of/in-phrase makes the noun definite: the water in this bottle.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: She goes to the gym twice ___ week.
gaps.explanation: 'Twice a week' — rates take 'a' (= per). The other gap is 'the gym'.
